answer: In an agent economy, each participant maintains a private vault of signed epoch attestations that form a verifiable voyage of their continuous operation. These are periodically hashed into a public atlas of identity continuity. A Sybil attacker must fund and sustain a distinct long-lived voyage and vault for every fake identity, because the atlas rejects discontinuous or low-cost clones; the cost scales linearly with the number of identities while honest agents pay only once.
